title: fix(app-showcase): write the expense approvals' decision back onto the report
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Fixes #25469

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

`showcase_expense_signoff` (per-group 会签, node `dual_signoff`) and `showcase_committee_quorum` (2-of-3, node `committee`) ran `start → approval → end`, with bare `end` nodes on both outcome arms. The approval request finalized, but nothing wrote the decision onto the expense report, so EXP-2001 kept reading `status: submitted` after both groups approved.

Each flow now runs an `update_record` on each outcome arm and has `runAs: 'system'`:

- approve → `mark_approved` → `status: 'approved'`
- reject → `return_to_draft` → `status: 'draft'` (the report goes back to the submitter, who can rework and resubmit; this is the same revert-on-reject `showcase_invoice_signoff`'s `flag_held` does)

`runAs: 'system'` follows the invoice flow's precedent. The write-back is an outcome of the approval, not an act of the submitter, so it has to land whatever the submitter's edit rights are.

Landing: `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts` (the file the claim names) plus the new pin `examples/app-showcase/test/expense-approval-write-back.test.ts`. No package source changed.

## Why `update_record` per branch and not the `approvalStatusField` mirror

I checked how the mirror behaves in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` (`mirrorStatusField` / `mirroredStatusValue`):

- It writes the request's status words exactly as they are: `pending` when the request opens, `approved` / `rejected` on a decision, `recalled` on a recall or dead-run sweep, `returned` on a send-back, and `rejected` on the revision-limit auto-reject.
- It has no value mapping. The spec key is a bare `approvalStatusField: z.string()`, and adding a mapping would mean editing `packages/spec`, which is out of bounds for this card.
- It writes only values the target field lists among its options. Any other value is skipped and the service logs a warning (`approval status 'X' was not written to OBJECT.FIELD`). The only exception is a transition that abandons the request, where it restores the value from before submission.

`showcase_expense_report.status` declares `draft / submitted / approved / reimbursed`. So a mirror on `status` would:

- skip `pending` and log a warning on every submit
- write `approved` correctly
- skip `rejected`, so a **rejected** report would keep reading "Submitted", which is the same defect on the other arm

The spec also says the mirror target "should be readonly on the object", and `status` is the field the submitter edits. When the decision drives a business-lifecycle field, the right tool is an explicit write per branch. Both flows' docblocks now explain this.

## Committee quorum flow

`showcase_committee_quorum` had the same gap, with bare `end` nodes on both arms. It gets the same fix.

## Pin

`test/expense-approval-write-back.test.ts` boots the production stack: a real `ObjectKernel` with the ObjectQL, automation and approvals plugins over real sqlite, and the app's real `ExpenseReport` / `ExpenseLine` objects and real flows. It opens each request the way the seed's `launchSignoff` does, then decides it through `ApprovalService.decide`. `describe.each` runs it over both flows:

- **approve**: after the first of two approvals the report still reads `submitted` and the request is not finalized. After the finalizing approval the run is `completed`, it stepped `mark_approved` and not `return_to_draft`, and the report reads `approved`.
- **reject**: the run steps `return_to_draft` and the report reads `draft`, a value the status field declares.
- **CONTROL**: the flow is rebuilt in its pre-fix shape (bare `end` arms, no `update_record` nodes) on the same harness. The same approvals finalize and resume the run, and the report stays at `submitted`, which is the defect as reported.

The committee case adds an expense line of 8,900 so the `total_amount >= 5000` start gate opens (the seeded EXP-DEMO is 8,900). The per-group case uses 1,500, under the threshold like EXP-2001.

### Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on committed HEAD `3e661a73f6`)

The mutation pointed the signoff approve edge back at the bare end node: anchor `{ id: 'e2', source: 'dual_signoff', target: 'mark_approved', label: 'approve' },` was replaced with `target: 'approved'`.

```
ablation-replace: anchor   x1 -> x0
ablation-replace: blob     a47c39e3548331eb29d0879152dd745527556d8c -> 78466ece32b2df854bf4e326c1c6ab5f8618a75f
     × approve: the report reads `approved` once the approval finalizes, not before
AssertionError: expected [ 'start', 'dual_signoff' ] to include 'mark_approved'
      Tests  1 failed | 5 passed (6)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (a47c39e35483) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The test went red under the mutation and green again once the file was restored. The example is source-imported by the test (relative `../src` import), so there is no `dist/` leg.

## Verification (head `3e661a73f6`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/expense-approval-write-back.test.ts`: 6/6 passed
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 38/38, Tests 461/461. The new test file is in the tsc program (`--listFiles`: 1 hit).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 45 commands, each run with its exit code recorded. 44 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt packages outside this diff's closure), so it is **NOT MEASURED** locally and left to CI.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 44 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.

No changeset: `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `private: true`, so nothing publishes (`skip-changeset`).

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` → `approvals.status-mirror-field` still records under `knownGaps` that no showcase flow declares `approvalStatusField`. That stays true after this PR, deliberately (see above). The checklist is not edited here.
- `showcase_expense_signoff`'s start gate has no amount ceiling, so a report of $5,000 or more matches both flows' start conditions on submit. The seed routes the two demos to different records on purpose. I did not measure what a live submit of such a report does, so this is noted here and not filed.
- On the issue's `lockRecord` question: the write-back runs after the request has left `pending`, and the lock is keyed on pending. It also runs as the system principal, which the lock hook exempts. The pin shows the write lands under `lockRecord: true`.
